scope: Storage review for commit 1; not the academic reverse engineering deliverable
method: Static inspection of configuration XML, direct credential matches in package files, connection-string contexts and own .NET assembly strings. Secret values are omitted.
decision: Store these twelve originals with AES-256-GCM; keep the key outside Git; preserve original SHA-256 and size for authenticated restoration.
false_positive_handling: Incidental binary matches without a password assignment or connection-string context were not treated as leaked credentials. ClassRRHH.dll Password fragments had empty values.
limits: Targeted static review does not certify the absence of every unknown secret.
Restored originals still contain their original credentials; encryption does not change the program.
No application execution or database restoration was performed.
